SELECT nr.*, c.name as customer_name, np.project_name, np.project_category, u.real_name as caregiver_name FROM nursing_records nr JOIN customers c ON nr.customer_id = c.id JOIN nursing_projects np ON nr.project_id = np.id JOIN users u ON nr.caregiver_id = u.id WHERE nr.execution_status IN ('未执行', '部分完成') ORDER BY nr.execution_date, nr.execution_time
SELECT execution_status, COUNT(*) as count FROM nursing_records WHERE execution_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY execution_status

SELECT u.id as caregiver_id, u.real_name as caregiver_name, COUNT(nr.id) as record_count, SUM(COALESCE(nr.duration, np.standard_duration)) as total_duration, AVG(COALESCE(nr.duration, np.standard_duration)) as avg_duration, COUNT(CASE WHEN nr.execution_status = '已完成' THEN 1 END) as completed_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN nursing_records nr ON u.id = nr.caregiver_id AND nr.execution_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} LEFT JOIN nursing_projects np ON nr.project_id = np.id WHERE u.role_id IN (2, 3) AND u.status = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.real_name ORDER BY record_count DESC

SELECT np.id as project_id, np.project_name, np.project_category, COUNT(nr.id) as execution_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN nr.execution_status = '已完成' THEN 1 END) as completed_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN nr.execution_status = '未执行' THEN 1 END) as unexecuted_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN nr.execution_status = '已完成' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(nr.id), 2) as completion_rate FROM nursing_projects np LEFT JOIN nursing_records nr ON np.id = nr.project_id AND nr.execution_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE np.status = 1 GROUP BY np.id, np.project_name, np.project_category ORDER BY execution_count DESC

mapper.select: SELECT DATE(nr.execution_date) as care_date, COUNT(nr.id) as total_records, COUNT(CASE WHEN nr.execution_status = '已完成' THEN 1 END) as completed_records, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN nr.execution_status = '已完成' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(nr.id), 2) as completion_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN nr.duration IS NOT NULL AND np.standard_duration IS NOT NULL AND np.standard_duration > 0 THEN ABS(nr.duration - np.standard_duration) * 100.0 / np.standard_duration ELSE 0 END) as duration_variance, ROUND(100 - AVG(CASE WHEN nr.duration IS NOT NULL AND np.standard_duration IS NOT NULL AND np.standard_duration > 0 THEN ABS(nr.duration - np.standard_duration) * 100.0 / np.standard_duration ELSE 0 END), 2) as duration_compliance FROM nursing_records nr JOIN nursing_projects np ON nr.project_id = np.id WHERE nr.execution_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(nr.execution_date) ORDER BY care_date DESC
